summary: Three churches (St. Michael's Penn Yan, St. Januarius Naples, St. Patrick's Prattsburgh) with weekend and weekday Masses, a Thursday Holy Hour, and Saturday confession at St. Michael's, all consistent across five bulletins. First-Saturday confession at St. Patrick's and St. Januarius is weekly; the matching Sunday confession is recorded only for November 8. Open: whether to add the website's 'sometimes' Wednesday 11:30 Adoration.
